page.layout: One column of running text with a centred heading ("CONCIO.") in its middle. No margin notes. Running head at the top right. Catchword at the lower right. Page number at the top left. Fragments at the far right edge belong to the neighbouring page and are left out.

main_text.l: ut pecunia pacem emerent, Mcbode[?] fatrapa ad du-
cem ablegato. Venit ergò ad Romanos Mebodes,
Persa, ac Imperator exercitus concione coacta, ad
ipsum audiendum, ordinem ductores, ac tribunos,
& auxiliares, reliquosque inter milites illustriores
convocat, qua colleƈta concione, Persa in hæc ver-
ba orsus est:
CONCIO.
Viri bellicosi, ne vero vos percutiat audientes
hoc Legati procemium. Si enim sententias muta-
veritis, mutabo & ego denunciationem: Excolite
pacem deposito bello, hastæque & gladius ut anti-
quata valeant, & pro militia capite sistulam lene
simul & pastorale canentem melos; Persarum rex
amans pacis est, cultu ornatur aptiore, non orna-
mentis bellicis. Regia enim est pacis placiditas, sicu-
ti tyrannorum propria Discordia. Viri qui estis
eodem modo nobiscum affecti, relinquatur bel-
lum solum omnibus rebus inexplebile. Sanguine
terram polluimus, sæpè mortem vidimus, mortem
cuius pictor est bellum, ego vero dico etiam ar-
chetypum, & humanorum malorum autor & ma-
gister per se & naturâ suâ. Pecuniam amat aliquis,
sed opibus & paupertate ludimur, aliquando victi,
vincentes aliquando, & iaƈtati simul cum belli for-
tuna ancipiti, perpetuam quasi volutationem pa-
timur. Superbit alius auro principum, cum volu-
ptate possidet perfidiam, quid enim in bello magis
est perfidum pecunia? absq; discrimine defertur ab
illo ad alium, & ab alio rursus ad alium, quasi si evi-

page.notes: The page number "90" at the top left is partly faint and read as 90 [?]. Doubtful readings: "Mcbode" (the same name appears as "Mebodes" later in the line, so the first letter may be an e) and "evi-" (printed "eui-", corrected to the consonant v). Long s is written as plain s. The small mark at the bottom left is a gathering signature that cannot be read and is left out. The fragments at the right edge are the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.
